business_model.description: What is sold and how it is charged: subscription, one-time sale, usage, or services.
business_model.x-ask: What do you sell, and how do you charge for it?

market_country.description: Country whose currency the model uses.
market_country.x-ask: Which country and currency should the model use?

document_language.description: Language for the prose. Headings stay as written in template.md.
document_language.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

research_mode.description: web when the cited pages were opened during this run. offline when they were not.
research_mode.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

pricing.description: Each plan or product with its price and billing unit.
pricing.x-ask: List each plan or product with its price and how it is billed.

current_customers.description: Paying customers now. Zero when pre-revenue.
current_customers.x-ask: How many paying customers do you have now? Say zero if you are pre-revenue.

current_mrr.description: Recurring revenue per month now. Zero when pre-revenue.
current_mrr.x-ask: What is your recurring revenue per month now? Say zero if you are pre-revenue.

starting_cash.description: Cash in the bank at the start of the model.
starting_cash.x-ask: How much cash does the company have now?

forecast_months.description: Months the model covers. The monthly table has this many rows.
forecast_months.x-ask: How many months should the model cover? Twelve is common for an early company.

costs.description: Monthly costs other than hires, each fixed or variable and labeled given or assumption.
costs.x-ask: List your monthly costs other than salaries: hosting, tools, rent, marketing. Say which are estimates.

hires.description: Planned hires and founder pay, with monthly cost and start month. One row that says none planned when there are none.
hires.x-ask: Who will you pay in this period, including founders, at what monthly cost, and from which month? Say none planned.

benchmarks.description: Published benchmarks used to judge the model, each from a page opened. A benchmark is not this company's figure.
benchmarks.x-unknown: Research this field and cite a source. Do not leave it blank.

drivers.description: Every input the model uses, with its value, label, and formula or basis.
drivers.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

monthly.description: One row per month. revenue = customers × price. net = revenue − costs. cash = last month's cash + net.
monthly.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

cash_chart.description: Cash at the end of each month. x matches monthly month and series matches monthly cash, in the same order.
cash_chart.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

annual_summary.description: Revenue, cost of revenue, gross profit, operating expenses, and net income for the model period, each the sum of the months.
annual_summary.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

break_even.description: The first month revenue covers costs, and the customer count it takes. Say when it does not happen in the model.
break_even.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

runway.description: Cash divided by average monthly net burn, with the lowest cash month. Not limited when the company is profitable.
runway.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

unit_economics.description: Revenue per customer, gross margin, churn, lifetime value, acquisition cost, and payback, each with its formula and benchmark.
unit_economics.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

default_alive.description: Whether the company reaches profitability on current costs and growth before cash runs out.
default_alive.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

default_alive_reason.description: Two sentences on the growth rate and costs behind default_alive.
default_alive_reason.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

scenarios.description: Pessimistic, Base, Optimistic, in that order. Each changes only the named drivers.
scenarios.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

sensitivity.description: One driver changed at a time, with its effect on ending cash.
sensitivity.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

funding_need.description: Cash to raise to keep a safety buffer in the pessimistic case. Zero when none is needed.
funding_need.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

funding_reason.description: One or two sentences on how funding_need was set.
funding_reason.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

reconciliation.description: Checks that the model adds up, and any difference from other plans, each with the result.
reconciliation.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

assumptions.description: Every assumed driver, with its inputs.
assumptions.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

sources.description: Pages opened for this model. Empty only when research_mode is offline.
sources.x-unknown: Research this field and cite a source. Do not leave it blank.
